title: Skill or sugar pill, on Fable 5.2?

price_estimate.basis: lib/models.js DEFAULT_PRICE, the most expensive known tier; no published price was read

budget_description: USD 375 admission budget; actual usage may overrun
max_usd_basis: the larger of Report 017 and Report 018 recorded usage repriced at the sampling maximum, times 1.5

routers.qualification: For find-skills, agent-browser, hyperframes and hyperframes-registry, these text tasks test the router's written response, not the delegated skill. Their results are excluded from verdict counts.
routers.headline: left out of the headline count

handoff.note: About grill-me and grill-with-docs: each skill's whole text is an instruction to call another skill. These text tasks forbid tools, so each reading reflects that one-line hand-off, not the skill it calls. Both stay in the pre-registered counts.

execution.next_run: reserve the attempt max_usd against the remaining cap before dispatch
execution.attempt_ceiling: stop an attempt at the first phase whose observed cost passes its max_usd
execution.continuation: one sealed receipt per attempt id across the manifest chain; an attempt without one is dispatched again, up to max_dispatches runs

projection.maximum_basis: per-draw means over 30 draws per arm and 90 judged draws
